description: The disallowed-key length guard uses strict less-than instead of less-than-or-equal, so a segment exactly as long as the longest disallowed key ('constructor', 11 chars) skips the prototype-pollution check
productionImpact: A path segment of exactly 11 characters (the same length as `constructor`) bypasses the `disallowedKeys` membership check, so `__proto__` (10 chars, still checked) is blocked but `constructor` itself is not — allowing callers to write `obj.constructor.prototype.isAdmin = true` and pollute every object in the runtime.
